title: E-invoice obligation in German domestic B2B
description: Since 2025, businesses must be able to receive e-invoices. Paper and other invoices may still be issued until the end of 2026, in 2027 only with prior-year turnover of at most 800,000 euros; from 2028 e-invoices are mandatory for everyone.
source: § 27 (38) UStG; BMF letters of 15 October 2024 and 15 October 2025 (as of 11 October 2026)
